leftEvidence.title: Jesus comes to John and speaks of fulfilling righteousness

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus comes from Galilee to be baptized; John resists, Jesus answers, and the baptism proceeds.
points.right: Jesus comes from Nazareth, is baptized by John, and immediately sees the heavens torn open and the Spirit descending.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: Opened heavens, descending Spirit, and a heavenly voice identify the beloved Son in whom God delights.
points.right: A voice directly addresses Jesus as beloved Son and names divine pleasure.

payload.posture: Both preserve Jesus, John, water, opened heaven, descending Spirit, and the voice.

rightEvidence.title: The heavens are torn open over Jesus

payload.tension: Matthew adds John’s objection and third-person proclamation; Mark uses torn-heaven language and direct address.
payload.title: Matthew and Mark at the Jordan
